audit.why: Early lane is Ryze's on range, mid is a wash around Rune Prison, late is his outright. Content and full agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike text writes 'Between the Worlds' — Aurora's R is Between Worlds.
audit.why: Fabricated ability name at the exact moment the reader needs the spike named correctly.
audit.corrected: Between Worlds; spike text now also states the untargetable rift crossing and names Realm Warp as his 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block never states the decisive Rune Prison rule.
audit.why: Rune Prison (615 range, 11s at rank 1 down to 9s) only ROOTS a target already carrying Spell Flux; without Flux it is a slow. That single condition decides every trade, and Spell Flux is on a 3.5s cooldown so he can re-apply it fast.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now names the Flux condition and the real 11s/9s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] is titled 'R defensively for nothing' but its body describes burning the hop.
audit.why: The don't and its explanation contradict each other, so neither lands.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to describe spending Between Worlds on chip.

edits.before: Between the Worlds zones the whole all-in — fights inside it are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Between Worlds zones the all-in and you cross it untargetable, so you can commit straight through a root. Reassess at 6 — Realm Warp changes his math.

edits.before: Between the Worlds zones the whole all-in — build your teamfight around that. Ryze carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Between Worlds zones the whole all-in — build your teamfight around that. Ryze carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control once his Tear stacks land.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rune Prison (11s rank 1, 9s maxed): only ROOTS if Spell Flux is already on you — unfluxed it is a slow you can walk. Trade after his Flux, not before. - Your ultimate: kill windows only, never chip.

edits.before: Burning the hop for damage spacing — it is your KA answer; without it you are a immobile drain bot.
edits.after: A 140s ultimate spent on poke leaves you with no untargetable escape the next time Rune Prison lands.
